meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任何文本背后的思维模式与认知风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从文字中读懂一个人的思考方式
copy.tagline_en: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand how someone thinks from their writing

howto.what: Claude会分析你提供的任何文本，根据12个认知维度（如分析深度、创造力、情感处理等）评分，并找出作者的思维模式、决策风格和认知特征，最终生成一份详细的认知画像报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“分析思考方式”、“认知画像”、“思维模式”等关键词，或直接提供文本并要求解读作者推理模式时触发。

say.text: 分析我的这篇博客文章，给我一份DHDNA画像
比较这两个人的写作风格，看看认知模式有什么不同
从我们的聊天记录中提取我的思维指纹
say.note: Claude会基于对话历史生成画像。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes any text you provide, scores it on 12 cognitive dimensions (Analytical Depth, Creative Range, etc.), maps tension pairs, identifies reasoning topology, and produces a detailed cognitive profile.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze thinking style, cognitive profile, or provide text for insight into reasoning patterns. Keywords include "thinking pattern", "cognitive profile", "DHDNA", etc.

say_en.text: Analyze my blog post and give me a DHDNA profile
say_en.note: Claude produces a cognitive profile report.

say_en.text: Compare the thinking styles of these two authors
say_en.note: Claude profiles each and compares them.

say_en.text: Extract my cognitive fingerprint from our conversation
